edges.reason: msg.sender is an untrusted caller used as mint recipient, payment source and burn target.
tx.origin == msg.sender gate creates tx.origin dependency and phishing susceptibility.
gold.burn external call runs before tokensMinted and ownership state updates.
mint increments tokensMinted by _amount and checks MAX_TOKENS.
mint calls _safeMint which can hand control to a malicious receiver callback.
mint performs an external call to treasureIsland.addTokensToStake after the mint loop.
mint calls selectRecipient to decide the token recipient.
mint calls getTokenToBeMinted to pick a token id from the pool.
mint calls isPirate to classify the minted token.
mint calls mintPrice to compute ETH or Penny cost.
mint enforces tokensMinted + _amount <= MAX_TOKENS.
mint reads gold.balanceOf and burns gold tokens.
mint uses treasureIsland for the stake flag and stolen token logic.
selectRecipient makes an external call to treasureIsland.randomPirateOwner before minting completes.
selectRecipient uses getSomeRandomNumber to decide the 10% steal chance.
getTokenToBeMinted derives its pool index from getSomeRandomNumber.
getTokenToBeMinted reads, overwrites and pops entries of _availableTokens.
getSomeRandomNumber sums balances of the _randomSource addresses.
getSomeRandomNumber mixes _randomCalls into the keccak entropy.
getSomeRandomNumber mixes _randomIndex into the keccak entropy.
getSomeRandomNumber mixes the mutable tokensMinted counter into the entropy.
getSomeRandomNumber includes msg.sender and block data, making randomness predictable and caller-influenceable.
mintPrice multiplies _amount by phasePrice[phase].
mintPrice performs an unchecked-in-spirit multiplication of user amount and price.
mint relies on mintPrice arithmetic to compute and compare the payment amount.
mint calls updateRandomIndex in non-phase-1 mints.
mint is guarded by whenNotPaused which reads paused().
shuffleSeeds uses getSomeRandomNumber to re-seed _randomIndex.
withdraw transfers the entire contract balance with a low-level value transfer.
withdraw is restricted to the contract owner.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received which performs an external call.
_checkOnERC721Received calls IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received on an arbitrary contract recipient.
_safeMint delegates the actual minting to _mint.
_mint executes _balances[to] += 1 balance arithmetic.
transferFrom performs the internal _transfer.
transferFrom checks _isApprovedOrOwner unless the caller is treasureIsland.
transferFrom hardcodes an approval bypass for the treasureIsland address, letting that contract move any token.
_transfer updates both sender and receiver balances.
_transfer verifies ownership via ERC721.ownerOf.
_isApprovedOrOwner resolves the owner with ownerOf.
_isApprovedOrOwner consults getApproved approvals.
_isApprovedOrOwner consults isApprovedForAll operator approvals.
giveAway pulls token ids from getTokenToBeMinted.
giveAway safe-mints tokens to an owner-supplied address, triggering the receiver callback.
internalAddTokens pushes ids into _availableTokens.
addAvailableTokens delegates to internalAddTokens.
switchToSalePhase fills the pool through internalAddTokens for phase 1.
onlyOwner setPirateId writes the _isPirate mapping.
onlyOwner setPirateIds batch-writes the _isPirate mapping.
onlyOwner setTreasureIsland rewrites the external treasureIsland dependency.
onlyOwner setGold rewrites the external gold dependency.
onlyOwner changePhasePrice rewrites phasePrice used for payments.
onlyOwner setBaseURI rewrites _apiURI.
onlyOwner changeRandomSource rewrites an address used as randomness entropy.
onlyOwner setPaused toggles the _paused flag that gates minting.
_baseURI returns the stored _apiURI value.
totalSupply returns tokensMinted.
constructor sets the initial owner to the deployer.
constructor safe-mints token 0 to the deployer.
constructor enables phase 1 through switchToSalePhase.
constructor initializes phasePrice entries.
constructor initializes the _randomSource addresses.
mint reads the requested amount parameter.
mint reads the stake flag parameter.
mint computes the local totalPennyCost from mintPrice.
mint fills the local tokenIds array when staking.
mint stores the selectRecipient result in the local recipient variable.
withdraw reads the destination parameter.
withdraw stores address(this).balance in a local variable.
getSomeRandomNumber packs the _seed parameter into the hash input.
getTokenToBeMinted stores the random index in a local variable.
mintPrice multiplies the _amount parameter by phasePrice[phase].

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _amount only parameterizes the mint function's token quantity checks and loops.
Parameter _stake only toggles the staking branch inside mint.
Local totalPennyCost is the amount passed to the external gold.burn call.
Local tokenIds is the array forwarded to treasureIsland.addTokensToStake.
Parameter to only sets the destination of withdraw's value transfer.
Local balance is the value sent by the withdraw transfer call.
Local recipient only carries the mint loop's recipient choice.
Parameter _seed only influences the getSomeRandomNumber hash entropy.
Local random is only the pool index used inside getTokenToBeMinted.
Parameter _amount of mintPrice is the operand of the price multiplication.
